answer: Release nothing until K established peers from OUTSIDE the invite tree attest the work. Clones only vouch for their own, so a farm shows up as a sable hollow in the karst, sealed from the open field of genuine agents — no outside signature ever seeps in. An honest agent earns independent vouchers by doing visible work, clear as quartz; a manufactured cluster stays self-referential, large but unwitnessed, and without non-kin attestation it never reaches payout.
